release.name: 9700E150_20261119v6
release.label: 20261119v6
release.title: IC-9700 E 1.50 + transverter + ICAP decoders, on-radio beacon & PSKReporter (20261119v6, apps 20261119v8)
release.description: IC-9700 E1.50 custom 20261119v6 (ICAP: decoders, beacons; PSKReporter fixed in the SD runtime files)
features: Transverter support: 8 slots (TRV1–TRV8, RF / IF on 2 m, 70 cm or 23 cm), RF shown up to 122 GHz
Separate active transverter for MAIN and SUB (SET > Transverter > MAIN Active / SUB Active); DUAL watch shows each receiver's own RF
MAIN/SUB exchange swaps the transverter selection together with the bands
SAT mode: transmit settings (power cap, TX delay, PTT inhibit) follow SUB Active; normal mode: MAIN Active
Per-transverter maximum TX power, TX delay (up to 300 ms, all modes) and PTT inhibit
CI-V frequency read/write in RF terms (6-byte BCD above 1.4 GHz, as IC-905)
Scope Set > Scope dB/div: 10 / 6 / 3 / 1 dB per division for spectrum and waterfall, noise floor anchored automatically (MAIN and SUB independently)
SD-card apps: MENU > SET > Apps (\IC-9700\Apps\)
Custom A/B bootloader: hold POWER while connecting DC (~5 s) to boot the other firmware slot
Opening screen shows 'customized by Dawid SQ6EMM - 20261119v6'; the radio's version text stays official 1.50
SD-card decoder apps (ICAP): Q65, FT8, JT4 and PI4 on the DECODE screen, WSJT-X-style output; WSPR-2 as a beacon-only app

Automatic PSKReporter spotting (fixed in this release - earlier releases never actually sent): every decode is reported when your own callsign and locator are set on the radio and it has network (the firmware carries no personal data; spot frequency is the true on-air RF, transverter-aware)

On-radio beacon: in a decoder mode, a LONG press of the mode tile in the emission popup arms / disarms a period-aligned beacon (DE <call> <locator>); while armed, a red rounded frame marks the main-screen emission button
Download the matching SD-apps bundle 20261119v8 on the patcher page and copy it to the radio's \Apps\ folder (the .BIN files must come from the same bundle)
The SD runtime (ICAPRT/ICAPTX/ICAPSPOT.BIN in the apps bundle) is updated separately from the firmware image: copy all three together and power-cycle

release.name: 705E140_20261119v9
release.label: 20261119v9
release.title: IC-705 E 1.40 + transverter + ICAP decoders, on-radio beacon & PSKReporter, Bluetooth DATA MOD (20261119v9)
release.description: IC-705 E1.40 custom 20261119v9 (v8 + Bluetooth audio as DATA MOD / DATA OFF MOD source: "USB, BT", "BT")
features: Transverter support: 8 slots (TRV1–TRV8, RF / IF), RF shown on the display up to 122 GHz
CI-V frequency read/write in RF terms
Per-transverter maximum TX power and TX delay (up to 300 ms, all modes)
Scope Set > Scope dB/div: 10 / 6 / 3 / 1 dB per division for spectrum and waterfall, noise floor anchored automatically
Custom A/B bootloader: hold POWER at power-on until the LED blinks (~3 s) to boot the other firmware slot
Opening screen shows 'customized by Dawid SQ6EMM - 20261119v8'; the radio's version text stays official
SD-card apps: MENU > SET > Apps (\IC-705\Apps\)
Extended TX ranges and 4 m (70 MHz) TX from the E base build
SD-card decoder apps (ICAP): Q65, FT8, JT4 and PI4 on the DECODE screen, WSJT-X-style output; WSPR-2 as a beacon-only app

Automatic PSKReporter spotting (fixed in this release - earlier releases never actually sent): every decode is reported when your own callsign and locator are set on the radio and it has network (the firmware carries no personal data; spot frequency is the true on-air RF, transverter-aware)

On-radio beacon: in a decoder mode, a LONG press of the mode tile in the emission popup arms / disarms a period-aligned beacon (DE <call> <locator>); while armed, a red rounded frame marks the main-screen emission button
DATA MOD / DATA OFF MOD: new 'USB, BT' and 'BT' options send Bluetooth (HFP) audio to the modulator, so a PC can run digital modes over Bluetooth with CI-V PTT (no VOX)
Download the matching SD-apps bundle 20261119v8 on the patcher page and copy it to the radio's \Apps\ folder (the .BIN files must come from the same bundle)
